title: An exact retuning of a 20,000-cylinder tetrahedron cover
statement: The closed tetrahedron and normalized cylinder-area functional in the pinned cylinder-covering sources admit a cover by at most 20000 triangular-base cylinders with normalized total area strictly less than 0.499921585997001774. The cover and strict rational area comparison must hold on the entire closed tetrahedron, including its boundary.
formalization_scope: No Lean proof or external kernel receipt for the new bound is included in this package.
comparison_summary: In the same closed tetrahedron, with summed Euclidean areas of compact triangular perpendicular bases normalized by the minimum projection area sqrt(2), e=13/125 and N=10000 give 20000 cylinders and R_new < 4999213/10000000 < 4999215/10000000 < R_old. R_old is the checked public e=1/10,N=10000 secant instance. The new count and area also improve the displayed OpenAI epsilon=1/2000 realization (16000000 cylinders), whose rigorous area lower bound is 11999999986997/24000000000000. The targeted search cutoff is 2026-10-17, completed at 2026-10-17T05:49:25.841189Z. This comparison refers to the documented checked public corpus, with no exhaustive historical priority or global optimality claim; see ATTRIBUTION.md for competing claims and scope limits.
attribution: OpenAI supplies the angular construction, secant axes and first-crossing argument. The public shjvandekamp repository supplies the quartic cap, overlap identity and padding theorem. This work supplies the rational parameter refinement and exact finite-area certificates.
